method.order: shuffled workloads each round; randomized baseline/candidate order within each pair

ladder_1.description: +/-2 V sine at 220+i Hz; ladder pole 1200 Hz, resonance 0.3, drive 1; zero cutoff CV.

vca_1.description: +/-2 V sine at 220+i Hz; OTA gain 1, unpatched CV normalizes to 10 V.

full_voice_1.description: Reference saw/ladder/OTA voice; semitone pitch bus; one 1.5 Hz clock/RC envelope broadcasts to all voices; audio adapter selects channel 1 but all voices process.

ladder_audio_cv_1.description: +/-2 V sine at 220+i Hz; cutoff CV +/-0.25 V at 997+i Hz, one V/oct; pole 1200 Hz, resonance 0.7, drive 1.5.

vca_audio_cv_1.description: +/-2 V sine at 220+i Hz; OTA CV 0.5..9.5 V at 997+i Hz, gain 1; signal/control are reconstructed together.
